entries.author: Joshua Marcus Bautista (Insight Global LLC)
entries.body:
The Portals Runtime
team has confirmed that the customer impact does not warrant communications at this time. As a result, Communication Engineering is disengaging. If it's determined that there is confirmed customer impact which requires communications,
Communication Engineering can be re-engaged
via the
request assistance
function in IcM.



entries.body:

Please
follow our TSG
for initial troubleshooting before engaging PG:
Troubleshooting Common Portal Issues.
For configuration issues, please try to reproduce it on a vanilla portal or
use PortalExpress tool
to mount a local portal with the support org for investigation.
For
reliability and performance issues
, please
attach fiddler trace
.
For all kind of issues, please run
portal checker tool
first (ask customer or check in unify) and analyze the result. If this does not help, please execute the
relevant kusto queries
and
provide the Activity/Correlation IDs
along with exact timestamp in UTC. You can find it as a response header(x-ms-request-id) in network trace.
Please do attach the result of your initial investigation if you still need help from PG.
If you have a general non-urgent query, please lookup our
stack overflow collection
or post your question there with tag
power-pages
, you will soon have an answer.



Last updated at 2026-08-25 12:39:24 GMT+5:30
What we know:
Impact
: Customer impact did not warrant communications at this time.
Portal identifiers and version information are not displayed in the service endpoint.
Customer impact was deemed insufficient for communications, and Communication Engineering disengaged.
What has been done so far:
The Portals Runtime team confirmed the customer impact did not warrant communications.
Communication Engineering disengaged after that assessment.
Re-engagement remains possible through the request assistance function if confirmed customer impact emerges.
Bridge Recap:
